items.title: Karur Vysya Bank net profit surges 45% to Rs 756 crore in Q1, asset quality sees slight slip
items.description: Karur Vysya Bank announced a significant 45% rise in first quarter net profit.  This increase brought their earnings to ₹756 crore compared to the previous year.  The bank's pre-provision operating profit also saw a substantial 36% jump.  Net interest income grew by 32%, boosting overall financial performance.  However, the bank's gross non-performing assets experienced a slight increase.

items.title: Adani Energy Q1 Results: Profit zooms 124% YoY to Rs 1,149 crore; revenue jumps 42%
items.description: Adani Energy Q1 Results: Revenue from operations rose 42% YoY to Rs 9711 crore.

items.title: Arvind Fashions Q1 Results: Net profit rises 11% to Rs 27.61 cr
items.description: Arvind Fashions reported an eleven percent rise in net profit for the first quarter.  Revenue from operations increased to one thousand two hundred seventy-eight point five crore rupees.  Direct channels contributed sixty-two percent of the company's total revenue.  The company experienced strong growth in online B2C sales by thirty-eight percent.  Arvind Fashions aims to accelerate profitable growth across its brands.

items.title: Bajaj Auto Q1 Results: Cons PAT surges 46% YoY to Rs 3,226 crore; revenue zooms 65%
items.description: Bajaj Auto Q1 Results: Bajaj Auto reported a strong Q1 FY27 with net profit up 46 percent. Revenue from operations jumped 65 percent, reaching Rs 21,689 crore. The company achieved record quarterly volumes and improved realisations across segments. Exports delivered their strongest-ever quarter, crossing 700,000 units for the first time. Commercial vehicle volumes also saw substantial year-on-year growth.
